LanguageData.DCP_Intro: While drafted, the player's command chain has absolute priority. Ordinary AI or melee auto attack may take over only after the player's command has actually finished.
LanguageData.DCP_EnableDesc: When enabled, issuing a player command starts a command gate. Ordinary autonomous AI jobs cannot take over until the current player command chain has finished and no player-forced orders remain queued.
LanguageData.DCP_MeleeAutoAttackDesc: Globally enables melee auto attack. In combat, each drafted melee pawn gets an individual Fire-at-will-style toggle. Auto melee starts only after player commands are finished and the pawn has returned to drafted idle.
LanguageData.DCP_MeleeAutoAttackRadiusDesc: Sets the maximum straight-line distance for automatic melee target acquisition. Range: 1-20 cells. Default: 4.
LanguageData.DCP_MeleeAutoAttackToggleDesc: Toggle melee auto attack for this pawn. It only operates while drafted idle with no active or queued player command. Uses the same hotkey as vanilla Fire at will.
LanguageData.DCP_LogBlockedDesc: Developer diagnostic option. Logs autonomous StartJob requests blocked while the player-command gate is active. Leave off during normal play.
LanguageData.DCP_BlockedCount: Blocked autonomous job replacements this session: {0}
LanguageData.DCP_AutoAttackCount: Automatic melee attack jobs started this session: {0}
